definitions.explanation: An abbreviation combining Japan/Japanese and England/English. Most commonly refers to the Japanese-English language pair in the context of dictionaries, translation, and language study.

examples.japanese: {日英|にちえい}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: Look something up in a Japanese-English dictionary.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日英|にちえい}⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}→作成：04186_sakusei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This document has been prepared in both Japanese and English.

examples.japanese: {日英|にちえい}⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{文化的|ぶんかてき}→文化的：05688_bunkateki⟧な⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: In Japanese-to-English translation, it is important to understand differences in cultural background.

notes:
An abbreviation combining ⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧ (Japan/Japanese) and {英|えい} (English/Britain). Most commonly refers to the Japanese-English language pair (for dictionaries, translation, etc.), but can also refer to Japan-Britain relations in diplomatic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日英|にちえい}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧: Japanese-English dictionary
- {日英|にちえい}⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧: Japanese-to-English translation
- {日英|にちえい}{対訳|たいやく}: Japanese-English parallel text
- {日英|にちえい}⟦{同盟|どうめい}→同盟：05321_doumei⟧: Anglo-Japanese Alliance (historical)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{英和|えいわ}→英和：04018_eiwa⟧: English-Japanese — the reverse direction (English to Japanese)
- ⟦{和英|わえい}→和英：05253_waei⟧: Japanese-English — synonym using {和|わ} instead of ⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧
- ⟦{日米|にちべい}→日米：13092_nichibei⟧: Japan-America — similar pattern with the U.S.
